mechanism.claim: In an already elevated cross-venue implied-volatility regime, aggressive BTC spot flow that appears first in exactly one alternative stablecoin quote book and then propagates to the second while USDT remains behind identifies ordered liquidity diffusion; the alternative-book direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the prior-hour alternative-book leader
mechanism.why_distinct: VGSFR is a two-hour ordered leader-to-follower transition across BTCUSDC/BTCFDUSD under a high BVOL-and-DVOL level gate. SQFD was a simultaneous alternative-book consensus event without a volatility regime; prior volatility candidates did not use stablecoin-quote flow topology.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: ordered quote-book diffusion plus dual implied-volatility levels is absent from Gross9 and does not use REX path geometry

clock.hours: two consecutive completed spot source hours p then c
clock.normalization: per-book robust z=(imbalance-prior720h q50)/((q75-q25)/1.349), shifted one hour, minimum 672; zero scale invalid
clock.leader_state_p: exactly one of BTCUSDC/BTCFDUSD has abs(z)>=1.0; the other has the same nonzero sign and abs(z)<0.50; side*s times z_USDT <0.25
clock.follower_state_c: the same leader and follower retain side s; follower abs(z)>=0.75; leader abs(z)>=0.50; s*z_USDT<0.50
clock.participation: current alternative-book volume share >= strict-prior 720h q50 with 672 observations
clock.volatile_regime: current completed-hour BVOL close and DVOL close are each >= their own strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset on an exact consecutive hourly source grid
clock.decision: current source-hour close after all three spot books and both volatility candles are complete
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.volatility: reuse hash-bound OCDR-12C BVOL/DVOL snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
